text:
olivia: @channel Quick heads up: Hosted Gen API v3 is GA. Streaming + tool-calling are production-ready and two new variants launched (redwood-mosaic-pro-2 and mosaic-lite-quant). Deprecation window for /v2 gen endpoints: 90 days.

marco: Amazing work team! Any hard changes we should tell customers about?

olivia: No auth changes. New optional params: `model_variant`, `streaming`, `allow_tool_calls`. Default behavior unchanged. We'll publish migration examples.

kevin: Rollout plan: canary -> ramp -> full over ~4h with health gates. Canary keys available via DM. Infra autoscale profiles tuned for larger batches.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for gen-service-pool at 1824000180

anya: SRE notes: dashboards added for gen.latency.{p50,p95}, streaming.session_errors, toolcall.err_rate, cache.hit_ratio. Alerts: p95 > 700ms or toolcall.err_rate > 0.7% -> page. Synthetic streaming checks every 60s.

marta: Docs preview (draft migration guide + examples): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-migration (pr #447). SDK streaming helpers pending small patch.

legal: Privacy update: tool-calling requires customers to declare external tool scopes in console. We'll deploy consent flow; migration guide will include schema for tool scopes.

olivia: Example curl for quick testing:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mosaic-pro-2\",\"model_variant\":\"hq\",\"streaming\":true,\"allow_tool_calls\":true,\"input\":\"Draft a short product blurb\"}'
```

kevin: Rollback plan: flip control-plane routing feature flag or route traffic back to v2 group. Estimated full rollback < 30m.

olivia: Customer comms: marketing will send GA announcement + migration checklist tomorrow. Ops will watch first 6 hours closely. Please report any anomalies to #eng-oncall and tag @anya. :rocket:
